caption:
Comment GUIDE and I'll send you the AI Affiliate Blueprint, free. The whole faceless model, written out.

Faceless AI affiliate marketing has four moving parts. That is genuinely all of it.

1. One recurring offer — something that pays again next month, not once
2. One faceless angle — screen recording, text on screen, or an AI voice over stills
3. A posting rhythm — thirty posts before you decide whether it works
4. One tracked link per angle — so you know which one did the work

What faceless actually means: the camera stops being the reason you don't post. It does not mean effortless. The work moves to picking the offer and showing up often enough to learn something.

What AI actually does: it writes the script, edits the cut and reads the voice, forty times a month. It does not pick your offer or read the market. The judgement stays yours. The volume is the machine's.

Before you promote anything, four questions:

Would you sign up to it yourself? If you wouldn't pay for it, the post will sound like it.

Does it pay every month? Or once, and you are back at zero.

Can you show it on a screen? No screen to record means no faceless post.

Would you still be using it in a year? A tool they keep is a payment you keep.

Three honest yeses, or leave it alone.

One more thing worth knowing: the cookie. It is a timer. Someone clicks and a note lands in their browser saying you sent them. Buy before it expires and you get paid. Thirty to ninety days is normal. Under seven and you carry all the risk.
